title: Cabin and Interior Space
summary: Feedback on cabin and interior space is mostly hard to interpret from the sampled fragments, but clear opinions praise roomy seating and overall interior room while one review criticizes cabin room versus competitors.

positive.summary: Positive reviews praise the roomy interior, generous cabin space, and comfortable spacing between the front seats.

negative.summary: One negative review says the cabin feels less roomy than Hyundai-Kia alternatives and that this is disappointing for Korean buyers.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined fragments mention space in unclear or non-evaluative ways, including parking-space detection, brief cabin-space references, and ambiguous comments about size or layout.

limitations: Most sampled fragments are undetermined, which limits confidence in a more specific sentiment summary.
Several undetermined fragments use the word 'space' for unrelated subjects such as parking-space detection or partial phrases, so the cluster is somewhat noisy.
The examples are stratified samples rather than representative estimates of all G60 reviews on this topic.
